entries.title: Meadow Markets
entries.tagline: A little farm. A growing adventure.
entries.description: Build your farm, grow crops, care for animals and explore a welcoming village. Start in your browser or take your farm with you on Android.
entries.requirements: Modern browser on phone, tablet or computer, or the Android app from Google Play. Internet access is needed for online features.
instructions: Open Play in browser and follow the farm introduction.
Tap or click a farm plot to plant, water and harvest crops.
Care for your animals, sell produce and use your coins to grow the farm.
Open the in-game help and journal for goals, controls and new activities.
entries.notes: Early access. Browser and Android releases update separately; the browser build shown here is not an Android package build number. Install and update the Android app through Google Play.

entries.title: Meadow Market Littles
entries.description: Explore farm adventures, animal care, puzzles and art with Farmer Jade, Farmer Rhys and Farmer Jay. Play 13 two-player games, including six cooperative adventures. Share one device or connect two devices across your home Wi-Fi.
entries.requirements: Modern browser on phone, tablet or computer, or the Android app from Google Play. Works in portrait or landscape. Internet access is needed for cloud saves and updates.
instructions: Open Play in browser and choose an activity.
Follow the farmers’ spoken instructions and on-screen controls.
Explore animal games, puzzles and the art studio at your own pace.
On Android, choose Get it on Google Play to install or update the app.
For a browser app, open game settings for installation. On iPad, use Safari Share, then Add to Home Screen.
entries.notes: Early access. Install and update the Android app through Google Play. Local two-player games use QR pairing on the same Wi-Fi, without an internet game server. Open and cache the game before going offline. Some guest networks block device-to-device connections. Game progress remains separate from Meadow Markets.

entries.title: Bargain Barge
entries.description: Browse Australian and New Zealand retailer offers and community deals, compare listed prices and open retailer pages in this Android testing app.
entries.requirements: Android 8.0 or newer. Internet connection for live feeds. Location permission is optional; you can choose a location manually.
instructions: Download the Android APK on your phone and open the downloaded file.
If Android asks, approve installation from your downloading app, then install and open Bargain Barge.
Select Australia or New Zealand and choose a location or enter a suburb.
Search for an item, filter results and open an offer to refresh its source details. Confirm the final price, delivery and availability with the retailer.
entries.notes: Android app only; there is no browser version. Listed prices are not a guarantee of branch stock or final checkout totals. App updates require your Android installation confirmation.

entries.title: Sponsor Sorter
entries.description: Find sponsorship partners, manage campaigns and conversations, and follow sponsorship activity from your Android phone.
entries.requirements: Android 7.0 or newer on a phone or tablet. Internet connection and a Sponsor Sorter account.
instructions: Open the installation page on your Android phone or tablet.
Download the signed APK and open the downloaded file.
If Android asks, approve installation from your downloading app, then confirm Install.
Open Sponsor Sorter and sign in with your existing account. New Android packages require your installation confirmation.
entries.notes: The public download is build 8. Later test builds are not listed until accepted for release. On iPhone or iPad, use the website.

entries.title: Frontlines: World in Conflict
entries.tagline: Six factions. Twelve battlefields. One world to conquer.
entries.description: Play Frontlines in your browser, on Android or on Windows. V1.0.0.107: Capital preparation, HUD dice and visibility optimisations; safer optional-map cache recovery; AI capital protection. Teams, trading pockets, gift codes and approved graphics retained.
entries.imageAlt: Frontlines: World in Conflict game artwork
entries.requirements: WebGL2 and WebAssembly browser, Android7.0+ (64-bit ARM), or Windows10/11 (64-bit Intel/AMD). Internet is needed for first load, online play and updates. Phone play is best in landscape.
instructions: Choose Play in browser, install the Android app through Google Play, or download the Windows setup EXE for your device.
Install and update the Android app through Google Play. Keep the existing app installed when updating to retain its local data.

On Windows, use the setup EXE. The ZIP is an internal update payload verified by signed update metadata, not a portable game. The installer is not Authenticode certified and may show an unknown-publisher warning.

Use the current game version for new online rooms. Updated players can also join compatible older matches. After a completed online game, select a player card to open the report menu. Reports are reviewed; an allegation does not automatically punish a player.
entries.notes: V1.0.0.107: Capital preparation, HUD dice and visibility optimisations; safer optional-map cache recovery; AI capital protection. Teams, trading pockets, gift codes and approved graphics retained.
